record.issue_text: [ADVISORY] The import task removes the documented `-c/--category` method_option and all category wiring with no deprecation note, changing the task's public CLI surface. Operators running existing `thor disqus:import -c <category>` commands break: the value is no longer a known option so it is passed as a positional argument to a task that takes none and the invocation errors, and there is no longer any way to direct imports into a chosen category instead of Uncategorized.

adjudication.rationale: The diff explicitly removes the public CLI option and its behavior: `method_option :category, aliases: '-c'` is deleted from `lib/tasks/disqus.thor`, along with all wiring that read `options[:category]` and passed `category: category_id` into `PostCreator`. The import now calls `TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title])` with no category support. This means existing operator invocations like `thor disqus:import -c <category>` will fail due to an unknown option, and there is no longer any mechanism in this task to target a category, changing/breaking documented behavior.
